'''Karka Vriskar''' was a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Scout/Legends|explorer]] and a member of [[Clan Askar]]. In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[200 BBY/Legends|200 BBY]], Vriskar was the first off-worlder to discover the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dressel/Legends|Dressel]], home of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Dressellian/Legends|Dressellian]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Following the initial discovery, the Bothans maintained frequent diplomatic contact with the Dressellians but otherwise did not interfere with their primitive society.<ref name="SOT" />

==Behind the scenes==
Karka Vri'skar was first mentioned in [[Stay on Target (sourcebook)|''Stay on Target'']], a supplement released in [[2015]] for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] roleplaying game.
